mentions.name: hpyhn
mentions.description: A website that helps Hacker News readers save time while browsing HN. It surfaces valuable comments buried in threads with fewer points, clarifies what posts are about when titles are misleading, and assigns every post a personalized interest score based on the builder's preferences to filter out uninteresting posts.
mentions.problem: Valuable comments are buried in low-point HN threads, good posts get ignored due to bad titles or unclear themes, and filtering out uninteresting posts isn't a simple yes/no decision, costing readers time.
